Maddrix is a professional services and technology company who's mission is to help the U.S. government, national security, critical infrastructure, and private sector organizations protect their trade secrets, mission critical programs, and national security information from targeted network attacks and nation state adversaries. Maddrix is in the inaugural class of only six incident response providers accredited by the National Security Agency under the National Security Cyber Assistance Program (NSCAP). Part of this evaluation included a comprehensive review of our incident response and mitigation protocol, our ability to develop and maintain highly qualified incident response staff, and integrate lessons learned into our incident response protocol.

It works by collecting thousands of individual data points from each endpoint on the network, and subjecting those data points to big data analytics, enabling the rapid identification of active and non-active threat actor activity and malware. Endpoint Analytics scales to any size network, and is free for U.S. government agencies we support.
